scope: Diagnose and restore raw rail-object continuity without persistence regressions

acceptance.strict_full_regression_gate: unchanged or better, with no new waivers; includes set O, ride and set F
acceptance.synthetic_removal: continued evidence must terminate at the bounded hold limit after object removal
acceptance.synthetic_transients: weak or transient evidence must not start a track or perpetuate an old STOP indefinitely

controls: Do not special-case known frame IDs, object distance or recording identity.
Trace current production detector stages before selecting a candidate.
Keep shipping defaults unchanged until full validation; validate proposed defaults in an isolated worktree.
Instrumented replay timings are diagnostic only, never latency evidence.
Known organizer inputs are development evidence, not new holdout data.

previous_rejected_candidate.failures: New raw unmatched detection; ride events 32 to 34; set F false detection regressions

validation_workflow_note: After targeted review, the identical effective candidate configuration is made explicit in isolated proposed defaults so the strict gate measures the exact files to be promoted. No metric or acceptance threshold changes.
